strategy: I tried to think creatively about how to describe the shapes. I often used animal analogies or compared things to houses or factories which seemed to work well. I tried to keep explanations simple and straightforward. When I had been playing with my partner for a while, I could use very brief descriptions and felt confident they would guess it. Similarly, as we played longer I rarely had to ask follow-up questions because I instantly knew the shape. When describing things in rounds 1 and 2, I tended to use longer descriptions to ensure it was clear and distinguishable from the other shapes I was describing.
enjoy: Yes, this was very enjoyable, particularly as we played for longer and developed a bit of a 'short hand'. At first I felt a bit rushed and like I was occasionally guessing or didn't have enough time to describe but as it went on I felt more confident in both roles and our descriptions to each other seemed to work well. I also found that their descriptions helped me think of different ways to describe things, so it improved my creativity. It was satisfying to  improve our performance as we went on because we had become more efficient.
feedback: No problems encountered. This was a really engaging and enjoyable study!
